blurb: Standalone copy-paste prompts for litigation matter management and case workflows. Each prompt runs on its own — paste it into a fresh AI chat to begin. Every output is a draft for licensed-attorney review.

prompts.title: First Run — House Setup
prompts.description: One-time interview that captures how you practise, producing a reusable Practice Profile you can paste into later litigation workflows. Optional but recommended.

prompts.title: New Matter Intake
prompts.description: Ten-step intake for a new matter: conflicts, jurisdiction, key dates and limitation periods, preservation, privilege, and procedural posture.

prompts.title: Matter Update
prompts.description: Log one event against a matter and produce a history entry plus a matter-log row update.

prompts.title: Matter Briefing
prompts.description: Short pre-call briefing on one existing matter, drawn from its saved summary, log row, and recent history.

prompts.title: Matter Close
prompts.description: Archive an ended matter with a closing history entry, a status update, and a closing summary block.

prompts.title: Portfolio Status
prompts.description: Weekly rollup across your matter log: risk distribution, upcoming deadlines, materiality totals, and flagged anomalies.

prompts.title: Outside Counsel Status
prompts.description: Draft per-matter weekly status-request emails to outside counsel across your portfolio, plus a run summary.

prompts.title: Chronology Builder
prompts.description: Build a fact chronology from pasted documents — theory-aware or production-centric and Bates-aware.

prompts.title: Legal Hold
prompts.description: Run the litigation-hold lifecycle: issue, refresh, release, or status check.

prompts.title: Privilege Log Review
prompts.description: First-pass privilege sort: make the obvious calls and flag every close one for attorney review.

prompts.title: Subpoena Triage
prompts.description: Triage an inbound subpoena — classification, scope and burden, objections framework, and a compliance plan.

prompts.title: Demand Letter Intake
prompts.description: Capture the pre-writing context for an outbound demand letter — parties, facts, basis, leverage — into a structured intake.

prompts.title: Demand Letter Draft
prompts.description: Draft an outbound demand letter after seven pre-draft risk checks. Higher-risk workflow; attorney review required before sending.

prompts.title: Demand Letter Received
prompts.description: Triage an inbound demand letter into a labelled triage report you can save to the matter file.

prompts.title: Deposition Prep
prompts.description: Build a deposition outline from pasted documents and case theory, tuned to the witness and their posture.

prompts.title: Claim / Element Chart
prompts.description: Build a claim or element chart — patent or civil, asserting or defending — mapped to the governing standard.

prompts.title: Brief Section Drafter
prompts.description: Draft a first version of a brief section in your house style — cited, theory-consistent, with verification markers.
